subject: Literature
title: The Epic of Gilgamesh
description: A quick, practical guide to The Epic of Gilgamesh.

hook.text: The oldest story ever written tells of a king who watched his best friend die and then searched for immortality.

buildup.text: The Epic of Gilgamesh was carved into clay tablets in ancient Mesopotamia over four thousand years ago.

discovery.text: It contains a flood story strikingly similar to Noah's Ark, written over a thousand years earlier.

twist.text: The tablets were lost for millennia and only rediscovered in 1853 buried beneath a collapsed Assyrian palace.

climax.text: Gilgamesh learns that immortality is impossible, and true legacy comes from what you build for others.

punchline.text: Humanity's oldest story is about accepting death.

quiz.question: What connection exists between Gilgamesh and the Bible?
options: Gilgamesh contains a flood story similar to Noah's Ark, written earlier
